probes.name: P1a
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/_goal_gate.py
probes.old: if not goal.check_criteria() and not goal.judge_criteria():
probes.new: if False and not goal.check_criteria() and not goal.judge_criteria():
probes.note: 🔴 AC-1 A1. Remove the hollow-goal guard and the gate is back to `all([]) is True`: a goal with no criteria reaches `passed` at its first Stop. The positive control `TestHappyPath::test_checks_only_goal_passes` stays green under this mutation — a one-check goal still passes — which is what proves the guard is scoped to the hollow case and not to every goal.

probes.name: P1b
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/_goal_gate.py
probes.note: AC-1 A2. The guard still refuses the pass (A1 stays green: status is `active`, not `passed`) but writes the generic warn marker instead of naming the defect. Only the marker claim reddens — witnesses that the trail entry is the SPECIFIC annotation the AC names, not any annotation.

probes.name: P1c
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/_goal_gate.py
probes.new:
if goal.enforce and False:
            _park_blocked_pending_human(goal, fingerprint, {}, detail)
probes.note: AC-1 A3. Skip the park under enforce and a hollow enforce goal falls through to the warn path — `active`, annotated, no park. A1 stays green (still not `passed`); only A3 reddens. V2-D4: evidence-missing under enforce is never a silent pass, and a hollow goal is the emptiest evidence there is.
